Arjun (Support): FYI customer BlueHaven reported a duplicate charge on INV-2026-0451 this morning; looks like reserved capacity billed twice during a pool restart.
Melanie (Finance): Can you paste invoice snippet and usage diff?
Arjun (Support): Snapshot: INV-2026-0451
- Reserved capacity 2026-05-02: $2,950
- Reserved capacity (duplicate retry) 2026-05-02: $2,950
Total billed: $5,900
Melanie (Finance): That meets manual adjustment criteria. Any prior credits? plan tier?
Arjun (Support): Dedicated - Standard SLA, no credits in last 90d. Root cause appears to be autoscale restart retriggering billing event.
Sam (Accounting): Recommend issuing a manual credit equal to duplicate line ($2,950). Approver required for >$2k. Tagging @Melanie.
Melanie (Finance): I approve goodwill manual credit for full duplicate amount. Please document remedial action request for infra.
Arjun (Support): Creating credit request: ```billing-cli credit create --invoice INV-2026-0451 --amount 2950 --currency USD --reason "duplicate reserved capacity from restart - goodwill" --approver melanie_finance```
billing-bot: Credit submitted CR-2026-9012 pending approval.
Sam (Accounting): I see CR-2026-9012, queuing for payout once approved.
Melanie (Finance): Approved in system. Memo must read: "manual goodwill credit due to platform duplicate billing; remedial: block retries on restart".
billing-bot: CR-2026-9012 APPROVED by melanie_finance at 2026-05-02T10:22:40Z. Credit applied $2,950. New invoice balance $2,950. Credit note generated.
Arjun (Support): Customer notified with apology and credit note. Customer: "Thanks for the quick fix, appreciate it." :thumbsup: 
Sam (Accounting): Filed JIRA INC-PIPE-221 to have engineering add retry-detection to billing events and to run a sweep for similar duplicates the past 7 days.
Melanie (Finance): I'll include this in the monthly adjustments review; escalate if we find a pattern.
Arjun (Support): Closing thread. Dropping outreach copy for records: "Hi BlueHaven, we found an internal duplicate charge on INV-2026-0451 and issued a full credit of $2,950. We're deploying a fix to prevent recurrence. Apologies for the inconvenience."
